selected.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell in front of your thighs with knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower the bell close to your legs while keeping your back steady.
Stop at a comfortable hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.

selected.name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
instructions: Attach a low cable to the outside ankle and stand side-on, holding a stable support.
Keep your pelvis level as you move the working leg sideways away from your body.
Return slowly without leaning or swinging your trunk.

selected.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back and position your feet for a comfortable step back.
Step one foot backward and bend both knees, keeping the front foot planted.
Press through the front leg to stand; reset your feet before the next repetition.

selected.name: Dumbbell Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and place your front foot on a stable low step.
Bend both knees to lower vertically, keeping your front heel down.
Drive through your front foot to rise while maintaining your split stance.

selected.name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Secure one end of a barbell in a landmine and hold the free end in front of your hips.
Soften your knees and hinge your hips backward, following the bar’s arc.
Keep your spine steady and drive through your feet to return upright.

selected.name: Cable Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
instructions: Kneel with one knee down, side-on to a chest-height cable, holding the handle at your sternum.
Brace and press the handle straight ahead without rotating your pelvis or shoulders.
Return the handle slowly and repeat before switching sides.

selected.name: Cable Pallof Hold
instructions: Stand side-on to a chest-height cable and hold the handle with both hands.
Extend your arms in front of your chest and resist the cable’s pull without twisting.
Hold while breathing normally, then bring your hands back and switch sides.

selected.name: Air Bike Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Pedal while alternately pushing and pulling the moving handles.
Keep your trunk steady and choose a pace you can sustain with control.

selected.name: Feet-Elevated Pike Push-Up
instructions: Place your feet on a stable low bench, hands on the floor, and lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up while maintaining control; use a lower support if needed.

selected.name: Typewriter Push-Up
instructions: Start in a wide-hand push-up position with a braced trunk.
Lower toward one hand, then shift your chest toward the opposite hand while staying low.
Press back up and alternate the direction without letting your hips sag.

selected.name: Wall Walk
instructions: Begin in a plank with your feet at a clear wall and hands on the floor.
Walk your feet up the wall and hands toward it only as far as you can control.
Reverse the steps slowly to the floor, keeping your trunk braced throughout.

selected.name: Prone Y Raise
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended diagonally overhead to form a Y, thumbs pointing up.
Draw your shoulder blades gently down and lift your arms slightly from the floor.
Lower slowly without lifting your chest or arching your lower back.

selected.name: Active Hang
instructions: Grip a secure pull-up bar and hang with straight arms.
Without bending your elbows, draw your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold while breathing, then relax your shoulders under control before dismounting.

selected.name: Negative Pull-Up
instructions: Use a stable step to reach the top of a pull-up with your chin above a secure bar.
Lift your feet from the support and lower slowly through a comfortable range.
Return to the step to reset instead of jumping into the next repetition.

selected.name: Towel Pull-Up
instructions: Loop two strong towels over a secure pull-up bar and grip one in each hand.
Brace your trunk and pull upward by bending your elbows and drawing your shoulders down.
Lower slowly; check the towels and bar before loading them.

selected.name: Skater Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent behind you and arms forward for balance.
Bend the standing knee and hip, lowering your rear knee toward a pad.
Press through the standing foot to rise; use support or a shorter range if needed.

selected.name: Single-Leg Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot near a stable support with your knee straight but not locked.
Rise onto the ball of your foot without rolling your ankle outward.
Lower your heel slowly, then repeat before changing legs.

selected.name: Frog Pump
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees comfortably open.
Brace your trunk and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips.
Lower slowly without arching your lower back.

selected.name: Band Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with a loop band above your knees and feet flat.
Keep gentle outward pressure on the band and raise your hips by squeezing your glutes.
Lower slowly while keeping your knees aligned over your feet.

selected.name: Band Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a secure loop band providing resistance between your legs.
Keep the working knee bent and press that foot backward and upward a short distance.
Return slowly without rotating your hips or arching your lower back.

selected.name: Band Fire Hydrant
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a loop band above both knees.
Keep your working knee bent and lift it sideways while keeping your pelvis level.
Lower slowly without shifting your trunk to the opposite side.

selected.name: Band Face Pull
instructions: Anchor a resistance band securely at face height and hold it with both hands.
Pull toward your face, spreading your hands and keeping your elbows comfortably high.
Return slowly without shrugging or leaning backward.

selected.name: Band Woodchop
instructions: Anchor a band securely near floor level and stand side-on holding it with both hands.
Pull diagonally across your body toward the opposite shoulder, allowing your feet and hips to turn together.
Return under control and repeat on the other side.

selected.name: Sprawl
instructions: Stand with room behind you, then bend to place both hands on the floor.
Step or hop both feet back into a braced plank.
Bring your feet back toward your hands and stand; use stepping for a lower-impact version.
